first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, and prior evidence supports onboarding simplification as a durable driver of time-to-value. I will verify the onboarding and activation records before committing, while avoiding promotional pricing because its retention harm conflicts with the sustainable-revenue objective.

final.rationale: Run a standard controlled onboarding-simplification experiment this week. The current decline in onboarding completion directly matches the problem addressed by the verified record, which showed a 13% completion lift, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and 3% higher 30-day retention. This is more aligned with sustainable qualified revenue than promotional pricing, whose retention harm remains a material risk. Activation messaging is also supported, but onboarding is the stronger first intervention because it addresses the upstream completion bottleneck.
